reflection.title: Walk the path.
reflection.description: A guided conversation with Scripture, your day, and the people who walk with you.
reflection.heading: Your reflection starts here
reflection.text: The next stage adds the guided form, Scripture selection, and saved drafts. This preview does not save journal entries yet.

story.title: Every stone has a story.
story.description: A place for bright days, hard days, and all the ways you have been helped.
story.heading: Room for your first stone
story.text: Your saved stones will appear here once the local journal is built. Your original journal has not been imported or changed.

tower.heading: My story
tower.description: Every stone holds a Scripture and a memory. Tap one to remember.
tower.label: Your tower of remembrance, oldest stones at the bottom
tower.order_one: {{count}} stone · Oldest at the bottom, newest at the top
tower.order_other: {{count}} stones · Oldest at the bottom, newest at the top
tower.latest: Return to your most recent stone in this view.
tower.referenceOnly: This Scripture reference is saved. Its passage text is not bundled with this journal view.
tower.encouragement: Thus far, God has helped you. He is the same God today.

form.confirmReadError: Read the passage and confirm before continuing.
form.readContext: Read slowly and consider what this passage says to you today.
form.prayer: How can we pray for you?
form.reflectionRequired: Write at least one reflection answer.
form.partner: Someone you would like to ask to pray (optional)
form.partnerNote: This saves a name only. No message is sent.
form.privateNote: This reflection stays on this device. Sharing and cloud sync are not enabled yet.

journey.selectionNote: There’s no right answer. Choose what feels true for you.
journey.mixedNote: Different feelings can sit together. There’s room for all of them here.
journey.description: Make room for your day. Find encouragement in Scripture. Carry a memory of God’s faithfulness.
journey.affirmation: You are loved. You don’t have to walk alone.
journey.note: Bright days and hard days both belong in your story. One moment, one stone at a time.
journey.takeYourTime: Take your time. There’s room for you here.
journey.heartTitle: Bring it all to the Lord.
journey.heartDescription: A little joy, a grateful heart, or something heavy. You can leave a few words here, or simply carry on.

heavy.label: Something heavy
heavy.text: Lord, I’m placing this in Your hands:

unsure.label: Hard to put into words
unsure.text: Lord, I’m not quite sure how to say this, but

journey.invite: Remember someone I could ask to pray (optional)

prompts.learned: Is there something you’re beginning to see in a new way?
prompts.questions: What are you still wondering about?
prompts.thoughts: Is there anything else you’d like to leave here?
prompts.prayer: What would you like to say to the Lord?

writing.stood: A word or a moment that stayed with me…

feel.title: What’s on your heart today?
feel.description: Choose the stones that feel closest, or share what’s on your heart below. There’s room for joy and heavy things together.

read.title: Spend time with the Lord.
read.description: Read slowly. There’s no hurry. You can open the whole chapter to explore its context.

reflect.title: Carry one thought with you.
reflect.description: Stay with what touched your heart. Write wherever the words come; one small thought or prayer is enough.

together.title: Who could walk alongside you?
together.description: Bring someone to mind who helps you feel supported. You can also keep this moment personal and continue.

stone.title: A moment worth remembering.
stone.description: Give this stone a memory. Choose its colour for yourself: bright, mixed, or hard. Every stone belongs.

support.overwhelmed: You don’t have to carry everything at once. Let’s make space for one moment.
support.anxious: Uncertainty can feel heavy. You can bring your worries with you here.
support.lonely: Being far from familiar people can feel heavy. There is room for your story here.
support.sad: You don’t have to find the right words. We can take this slowly.
support.afraid: You can begin just as you are, with the things that feel uncertain.
support.tired: There’s no hurry. Let this be a small moment of rest.
support.ashamed: You are welcome here, even with the things that are hard to say.
support.homesick: You can miss home and be building a life here. Both feelings belong.
support.uncertain: Finding your way takes time. You don’t need every answer today.
support.grateful: Let’s hold onto this little light and remember what brought you joy.
support.hopeful: Even a little hope is worth remembering. Let’s walk with it.

word.loading: Making space for a Word for your day…
word.downloading: Finding a little encouragement for your day…
word.searching: Finding encouragement from what you shared…
word.download: First use may download about 145 MB and needs internet. Once prepared, search can work offline. Your words stay on this device.
word.note: Scripture in English. Read the passage in its context.
word.chapter: Spend time with the whole chapter
word.another: Spend a moment with another passage
word.bundled: Continue with a word of care

errors.setup: Scripture search isn’t ready on this device yet. You can try again online, or continue with a saved word of care.
errors.tooLong: These words are longer than the search model can read. You can return to your heart space and shorten them, or continue with a word of care.
errors.search: We couldn’t bring a passage forward just now. Try again, or continue with a word of care.

evening.title: How was your day?
evening.description: What happened today, and how are you feeling now? Bring it in your own words. We’ll find a passage to explore with your evening reflection.
evening.wordNote: Your morning Word. Next, explore a passage connected to what you share about your day.

manage.backupNote: Backups contain your personal reflections. Keep them somewhere private. Imports add new stones and skip existing IDs; they never overwrite your journal.
manage.deleteDescription: This removes the stone from this device. You can restore it only if you have a backup.
manage.invalidBackup: Choose a valid Ebenezer journal backup, version 1, no larger than 10 MB. No records were imported.
manage.changeFilters: Try another search, tone, or date range.
manage.exportTooLarge: This journal exceeds the 10 MB backup limit. A backup was not downloaded.

summary.title: Remembering His faithfulness
summary.description: Pause with your whole tower, through hard, mixed, and bright days.
summary.privacy: When you choose to reflect, only totals of hard, mixed, and bright days are sent to Google AI. Private words, names, dates, feelings, and locations stay on your device. This is a gentle Scripture-grounded reflection, not a reading of your journal. Google’s free tier may use requests to improve its products.
summary.signIn: Sign in for an AI reflection
summary.offline: Connect to request a reflection. Your stones are still here.
summary.failed: The reflection could not load. Please try again.
summary.revisit: Tap a stone above to return to its memory and Scripture.

source.prepared: Prepared reflection · AI is currently unavailable.

summary.localMessage: There is room here for both the hard days and the bright ones. God’s love is not measured by how easy your day felt. As you look back, bring Him your gratitude, your questions, and what still feels unfinished.
summary.gathering: Taking a moment with your journey…
summary.aiNote: Written with Google AI from your stones: their days, verses, thoughts and reflections.
summary.ask: Write me a reflection with AI
summary.disclosure: Sends the words of your recent stones to Google AI, only when you tap. Skip it and nothing leaves this device.

evening.title: Good evening.
evening.description: Let’s walk back through your day together, one gentle step at a time.
evening.thoughtLead: And you chose to carry this thought with you:
evening.question: So, how was your day? Tell Him about it, the bright moments and the heavy ones.
evening.feel: How are you feeling right now?
evening.ownWords: Or tell Him in your own words.
evening.findWord: Find a Word for my day
evening.wordTitle: Here is a Word for what you shared.
evening.wordNote: Read slowly. There’s no hurry. Let it meet you where you are tonight.
evening.reflectTitle: What is this Word saying to you?
evening.reflectNote: Write wherever the words come. One small thought or prayer is enough.

prompts.questions: Is there anything you’re still wondering about?

evening.dayTone: What kind of day was it?
